application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: 1 x Mature Pittosporum (applicants ref. T1) - Approximately 5.00m: Reduce crown by up to approximately 1.00m all round.  Remove major dead wood. General maintenance.1 x Leaning Lilac (applicants ref. T2) - Approximately 2.00m: Fell to ground level.  This plant is rather old and has been suppressed by T1, It is taking up planting space. 1 x Magnolia Grandiflora (applicants ref. T3) - Approximately 7.00m: Reduce crown back to previous by approximately 1.20m all round. Reduce by up to 1.50m over the boundary to help control encroachment. Remove ivy above fence height. General maintenance/Control encroachment.1 x Mature Quince (applicants ref. T4) - Approximately 3.00m: Reduce back to previous reduction points approximately 0.50m. Remove dead wood. Thin crown density by approximately 30%. General maintenance.1 x Deciduous Magnolia (applicants ref. T5) - Approximately 6.00m: Tip prune to reduce by approximately 1.20m. Thin crown density by 20%. Remove dead wood. General maintenance.
